title: Putnam County, FL, Hog Wild Country Cafe faces an administrative complaint due to 11 violations - NewsBreak
text:
13 hours ago Hog Wild Country Cafe was recently cited for 11 violations. Photo by Mike K/Yelp Hog Wild Country Cafe in Interlachen, Putnam County, FL, failed a routine health inspection on December 18, 2025, receiving 11 total violations that triggered a follow-up inspection requirement and an administrative complaint recommendation from the Florida Department of Business & Professional Regulation.
What The Inspection Showed
The inspection documented two high-priority violations, two intermediate violations, and seven basic violations at the restaurant located at 1116 State Road 20.
Inspectors found high-priority violations that included mashed potatoes and egg roll mix stored at unsafe temperatures of 46 and 49 degrees Fahrenheit in a three-door glass cooler with a broken pane. Food must be kept at 41 degrees or below to prevent bacterial growth that causes foodborne illness.
The items were stored in the section behind the broken glass pane, which was covered with cardboard for insulation. Staff discarded both products during the inspection, and a stop-sale order was issued to prevent the food from being served to customers.
Other Violations Found
The intermediate violations included food residue staining on a portable cutting board and wait station cooler surfaces. Inspectors also issued a warning because the restaurant made renovations without submitting required plans to state regulators, including a non-functioning walk-in cooler and an enclosed smoker added to the building.
Basic violations covered general sanitation and maintenance issues. Inspectors found employee personal belongings stored near food preparation areas, including phones and jackets placed over wrapped bread. A jug of fryer oil sat on the floor beneath a prep table, which was marked as a repeat violation from previous inspections.
State records showed that equipment problems included ice buildup in multiple freezers, grease and burn debris on hood filters, and wet pans stacked together before proper drying.
The administrative complaint recommendation means state regulators will review whether formal disciplinary action is needed if the situation isn't rectified when they return for the follow-up.
Although Hog Wild Country Cafe, which holds a 4.6-star rating from 651 Google reviews, was not ordered to close, the establishment must pass a follow-up inspection before returning to good standing with health authorities.
